verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents "Rico", a built-in AI assistant in the dashboard that lets users ask plain-language questions about their data instead of digging through charts (revenuecat-docs-10). This shows a built-in assistant capability, but evidence only covers Q&A/insight generation, not broader task delegation or action-taking within the product, and there's no independent/community corroboration of its real-world reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of Rico performing actions/tasks beyond answering questions, and independent user reports validating its usefulness.
